comparison.objective: Press a lamp cord into a raceway and insert its plug while avoiding unsafe routing; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-cable routing, distributed pressing, and plug insertion versus rigid-tool engagement, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and lock torque.
comparison.success_condition: Cord retained in the raceway, plug seated, rug unmoved, and no walkway hazard versus two bounded, non-bottoming impact cycles and retained setting. Numeric routing tolerances are absent; specs are empty.
comparison.reason: Cable management tests deformable routing and terminal insertion, not tuning and locking a rigid energy absorber.
